title: player.json
description: One lecture's slides for a player that shows each slide while its part of the lecture audio plays. Written by slides.render; slides.assemble fills in audio, narration, start_ms and end_ms. Paths are relative to the player.json file.

version.description: Schema version, incremented on incompatible changes.

name.description: The lecture's output name, such as "lecture-01".

number.description: The lecture number, or null for an unnumbered lecture.

audio.description: The lecture MP3, relative to player.json. Null until slides.assemble runs, or if there is no audio.

n.description: The section number, counted across the whole course: the N in the transcript's "## [N] Title" heading and the audio chapter "[N] Title".

source.description: The file the slide came from, relative to the course materials directory.

locator.description: Where in the source: "page 3", "slide 2", "section 4", "cell 5", or null for the whole file.

image.description: image slides: the WebP image, relative to player.json.

width.description: image slides: the image width in pixels.

height.description: image slides: the image height in pixels.

markdown.description: markdown slides: the slide's text as Markdown, with math in LaTeX ($...$ and $$...$$). May be empty.

language.description: code slides: a syntax highlighting language name, such as "python" or "scheme".

narration.description: What the lecture says while this slide shows, from the transcript's "## [N]" section. Null until slides.assemble runs.

start_ms.description: Where the slide's narration starts in the audio, in milliseconds. Null until slides.assemble runs.

end_ms.description: Where the slide's narration ends in the audio, in milliseconds. Null until slides.assemble runs.
